items.question: Under what condition must a hundred-thousand be assigned to the place marked by the forehead-syllable mass when offered in the context of god-worship after completion of the rite?
premises: The mark lies in the mass of syllables at the forehead.
A count of a hundred-thousand is to be assigned to that mark.
This assignment follows the completion of the prescribed rite for the god-worshipped object.
items.inference: The hundred-thousand is to be placed at the forehead-syllable mass after the rite has been completed in the god-worshipped context.
uncertainties: Exact ritual scope of the assignment remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having done the rite, place a hundred-thousand at the spot situated in the mass of forehead syllables, in the context of what is worshipped by the gods.
